title: Macquarie Capital Alliance Group (MCAG) - proposed merger with the Regis Group

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under Merger Review Process Guidelines
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Macquarie Capital Alliance Group's proposed merger with the Regis Group.
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed merger has been considered in the context of local markets for the provision of aged care facilities.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considers that the proposed merger is unlikely to substantially lessen competition as: - limited competitive overlap exists between the operations of the parties' aged care facilities, and in local areas where there is some overlap, the proposed merger would not remove a major competitor; - the local markets appear to be highly fragmented and contain numerous substitutes; and - the prices for the provision of aged care services may be constrained to some extent by government regulation.
